source.title: BUYPASS InComm Market Basket Data Format

lessons.scope: Document lineage, page 2; no prior version exists
lessons.statement: Version 2023-1, released August 18, 2023, is the first release of the InComm Market Basket Data Format.

evidence.quote: This is a new document.
Created the document

lessons.scope: Format lineage, page 4; the InComm ISO 8583 specification itself is not ingested
lessons.statement: Market Basket Data is formatted per rules adapted from the InComm ISO 8583 Generic Interface Specification, Version 6.2.3, Appendix B.

evidence.quote: adapted from the InComm ISO 8583 Generic Interface Specification, Version 6.2.3, Appendix B

lessons.scope: Transaction type codes, page 4; the carrier field is ATL105 Segment 111 Table 049 Sub-Table 09 per the cross-reference map
lessons.statement: The transaction type is the 3-digit value sent in Merchant Supplementary Data: 310 Benefit Eligibility & Balance Lookup, 910 Item Qualification, 920 Limited Spend, 200 Limited Spend Refund.

evidence.quote: it is referring to the 3-digit value entered as part of the Merchant Supplementary Data
310 Benefit Eligibility & Balance Lookup
910 Item Qualification
920 Limited Spend
200 Limited Spend Refund

lessons.scope: Dataset envelope, page 4; applies to every dataset tag
lessons.statement: Each dataset is a modified TLV: a 2-character Tag, a 3-digit numeric Length, an 8-byte bitmap, then the dataset field values.

evidence.quote: Each dataset is formatted in a modified TLV method
A two-character Tag to identify the dataset
A three-digit numeric Length
An eight-byte Bitmap for the dataset.

lessons.scope: Length semantics, page 4
lessons.statement: The Length counts the bitmap(s) and all primary and continuation elements, but not the Tag or the Length itself.

evidence.quote: but does not include the length of the Tag or Length elements

lessons.scope: Bitmap encoding, page 4; bit-to-character mapping is QE interpretation INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q16
lessons.statement: Dataset bitmaps are 32-bit bitmaps represented by eight ASCII bytes (eight hexadecimal characters).

evidence.quote: implemented as 32-bit bitmaps, represented by eight bytes of ASCII data

lessons.scope: Worked example, page 4; the ASCII rendering is authoritative per QE interpretation INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q13
lessons.statement: A DV dataset carrying only Bit 2 with value 01.01 is rendered as DV0134000000001.01 (Tag DV, Length 013, bitmap 40000000, value 01.01).

evidence.quote: The dataset contains only Bit 2 with the value

lessons.scope: Dataset inventory, pages 4-5
lessons.statement: Five datasets are defined for InComm Healthcare (IH): DV Data Version, PI Purchase Item, PU Purse, OF Offer and OC Offer Counts.

evidence.quote: There are multiple datasets defined for InComm Healthcare (IH):
A Purchase Item dataset indicates shared values among a quantity of the same product.
A Purse dataset indicates each active purse associated with a
An Offer Counts dataset contains the information necessary to track the usage of offers

lessons.scope: OF/OC applicability, page 5; real-time vs non-real-time scope is open question INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q01
lessons.statement: OF and OC datasets are restricted to retailers whose IH solution does not exchange a market basket in real time.

evidence.quote: only those retailers who implement an IH solution that does not exchange a market basket in real time.

lessons.scope: DV obligation and Dataset Version, page 5; the actual MM.mm value must come from InComm (INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q07)
lessons.statement: The DV dataset is required for all new IH implementations; Bit 2 Dataset Version (MM.mm) is required and its value is supplied by an InComm integration project resource.

evidence.quote: The DV dataset is required for all new implementations of IH.
An InComm integration project resource will provide the value.

lessons.scope: DV conditional fields, pages 5-6
lessons.statement: Offer File Version (Bit 3) and Purse File Version (Bit 4) are required only when the implementation does not exchange a market basket in real time, and are not applicable otherwise.

evidence.quote: 3 C Offer File Version n 6
Required when an implementation does not exchange a market basket in real time, and not applicable otherwise.

lessons.scope: PI obligation, page 6
lessons.statement: A PI dataset is required when IH must evaluate the market basket to authorize a discount, payment or refund.

evidence.quote: The PI dataset is required when evaluation of the market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 2 Item Code, page 6
lessons.statement: Item Code (n 14) is the UPC/EAN13 without check digit, right-justified and zero-filled; suppressed codes must be expanded.

evidence.quote: Does not include check digit.
Code is right justified, zero filled.
Suppressed codes must be expanded.

lessons.scope: PI consolidation rule, page 6
lessons.statement: Quantities are combined into a single PI when Bits 2, 5, 10, 11, 17 and 18 are identical.

evidence.quote: Quantities should be combined into a single PI when the value of Bits 2, 5, 10, 11, 17, and 18 are the same.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 5 Price, page 6; units are open question INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q06
lessons.statement: Price is the single retail price shared by all items in the PI, net of store and manufacturer discounts/coupons; tax is excluded on a 910 request.

evidence.quote: Single retail price shared by all items in the PI Dataset net any store and manufacturer discounts and/or coupons.
Do not include tax in a 910 request.

lessons.scope: PI MBAS discount totals, pages 7 and 9
lessons.statement: The InComm (MBAS) discount total is quantity times per-item amount: manufacturer = Bit 6 x Bit 7, store = Bit 15 x Bit 16.

evidence.quote: The total IH manufacturer discount is equal to Bit 6 multiplied by Bit 7.
The total IH store discount is equal to Bit 15 multiplied by Bit 16.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 9 Redemption Request Amount, page 7
lessons.statement: Redemption Request Amount is extended price (quantity x net unit price) plus applicable tax, in cents, and is required for 920 and 200.

evidence.quote: Total redemption request amount for this item code (extended price + all applicable taxes, where the extended price = Quantity * unit Price).
Amount in cents (for example, $100 is represented as 000000010000).
Required for 920 and 200.

lessons.scope: PI POS discount fields, pages 7-9
lessons.statement: POS-applied manufacturer/store discount amounts (Bits 10, 17) are already netted out of Price; their Type (Bits 11, 18: P, E, M, X) is required when the amount is present or when no further discounts are allowed.

evidence.quote: Note that the Price field is already net of this amount.
This field is required if the Manufacturer Discount Amount is present, or when no further Manufacturer Discounts are allowed by POS rule.
This field is required if the store Discount Amount is present, or when no further Store Discounts are allowed by POS rule.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 12 Adjustment to Price, page 8
lessons.statement: Adjustment to Price is the amount InComm paid or discounted for the whole PI, including the quantity multiplier (e.g. 2 x $0.75 = $1.50), in cents.

evidence.quote: the amount paid by InComm including any multiplying effect of quantity for the PI dataset.
the product of 2 * $0.75.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 13 Item Reference Number and response splitting, page 8
lessons.statement: Item Reference Number must be unique per PI across the whole request (not necessarily contiguous); responses may be unordered and a multi-quantity PI may be split, each part keeping the original Item Reference Number.

evidence.quote: This number must be unique per PI on the request. The uniqueness applies to the whole message.
PI datasets are not necessarily returned in the order sent to the host.
will bear the same Item Reference Number as was contained in the original request.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 14 Purse ID, page 9
lessons.statement: Purse ID links a PI to a PU; 000 means no purse association, and Item Qualification responses always carry 000.

evidence.quote: A value of zero (000) in this Bit indicates that the PI is not associated with a PU.
The Purse ID on Item Qualification responses is set to zero (000)

lessons.scope: PI applicability by transaction type, pages 10-11
lessons.statement: PI is optional in a 310 and absent when no market basket is exchanged; responses may split quantities across PIs, and Adjustment to Price is not returned on a 310 because it is a preauthorization.

evidence.quote: A PI dataset is optional in a Benefit Eligibility & Balance Lookup (310).
The quantity can be split up into multiple PIs in the response
The adjustment to price is not provided on a 310 as this is a preauthorization.

lessons.scope: PU cardinality, page 11
lessons.statement: PU datasets appear only in IH responses, one per active purse on the account, including purses with a zero balance.

evidence.quote: One PU dataset is returned for each active purse associated with an account.
Purses with no balance (e.g., 0.00) remaining are included in the response.

lessons.scope: PU consumer display, page 11
lessons.statement: Purse Description should be shown to the consumer with the balance at the end of the transaction.

evidence.quote: This value should be presented to the consumer along with the balance at the conclusion of a transaction.

lessons.scope: PU Bit 6 Amount Authorized, page 12
lessons.statement: Amount Authorized is never negative, is zero for declined or uninvolved purses, and is required for 920 and 200.

evidence.quote: This amount is never negative.
for purse declines or for purses not involved in the transaction
Required for 920 and 200

lessons.scope: PU non-real-time fields, page 12
lessons.statement: Purse Unique ID (Bit 8) and Redemption Request Amount (Bit 9) apply only to implementations that do not exchange a market basket in real time.

evidence.quote: Applicable only to an implementation that does not exchange a market basket in real time, and not applicable otherwise.

lessons.scope: PU requirement matrix, pages 12-13; duplicated response columns are open question INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q03
lessons.statement: PU field requirements are tabulated per transaction type, with the request side defined only for 920 & 200.

evidence.quote: This table presents all the PU fields and their requirements per applicable Transaction Type.

lessons.scope: OF obligation and print text, page 13
lessons.statement: OF is required for non-real-time IH implementations; Offer Print Text (max 25) is designed for the receipt and Offer Verbiage (max 100) is the readable version.

evidence.quote: The OF dataset is required for implementations of IH which do not exchange a market basket.
Designed to be printed on the receipt.

lessons.scope: OC obligation and Type values, pages 14-15; transaction mapping is open question INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q05
lessons.statement: OC is required for non-real-time IH implementations. Account Lookup responses use tallyEarn, tallyRedeem, redeemedCount; Offer Redemption requests use incrementedEarn, incrementedRedeem, timesRedeemed, totalAmountAwarded.

evidence.quote: The OC dataset is required for implementations of IH which do not exchange a market basket.
In an Account Lookup response, the valid types are:
In an Offer Redemption request, the valid types are:

lessons.scope: OC Amount and totalAmountAwarded, pages 14-15
lessons.statement: OC Amount is in pennies; totalAmountAwarded must be converted by the retailer to an amount for quantity- or percentage-based offers.

evidence.quote: Indicates an amount in pennies of a monetary count.
will need to be converted by the Retailer to an amount when redeeming quantity or percentage-based offers.

lessons.scope: OF requirement matrix, page 14
lessons.statement: A 910 request carries only the OF Offer ID; a 310 response carries Offer ID, Offer Tag, Offer Print Text and Offer Verbiage.

evidence.quote: This table presents all the OF fields and their requirements per Transaction Type.

lessons.scope: OC requirement matrix, page 16; caption wording is open question INCOMM-MBD-2023-1-Q04
lessons.statement: A 910 request requires OC Offer ID with Times, Amount and Type conditional; in a 310 response all OC fields are conditional.

evidence.quote: 1.11 OC Dataset Field Usage

lessons.scope: PI split causes, page 8; describes why one request PI becomes several response PIs
lessons.statement: A multi-quantity PI may be split in the response when a discount applies to only part of the quantity (Item Qualification), when a purse balance is depleted giving a full payment PI, a partial payment PI and a not paid PI (Limited Spend), or when several purses fund the items (Limited Spend).

evidence.quote: Item qualification responses when a discount is eligible only for part of the quantity submitted
either a purse balance has been depleted (full payment PI, partial payment PI, not paid PI)
multiple purses are used to fund items.

lessons.scope: PI Bit 9 tax treatment, page 7; explains why the redemption amount cannot be recomputed from message data
lessons.statement: Tax in the Redemption Request Amount follows the retailer's POS business rules, and states differ on whether discounts are taxed.

evidence.quote: Some states tax discounts and some do not.
This amount includes any applicable tax for the item based on retailer business rules applied at the POS.

lessons.scope: PI usage table colour key, page 10; identifies which party supplies each discount field
lessons.statement: In the PI usage table, orange rows (Bits 10, 11, 17, 18) are discounts the retail partner sends in the request and blue rows (Bits 6, 7, 15, 16) are discounts InComm returns in its response.

evidence.quote: Rows in orange represent discount information conveyed by the retail partner in the request, and rows in blue represent discount information conveyed by InComm in its response.

openQuestions.question: Does the BUYPASS InComm OTC implementation exchange the market basket in real time? ATL105 Segment 151 allows only DV + up to 10 PI and Segment 152 DV + PI + PU, while this document also defines OF, OC, DV Bits 3-4 and PU Bits 8-9 for non-real-time implementations. Confirm whether those non-real-time structures can ever appear in Segment 151/152.
openQuestions.qeDecision: User answered Unknown on 2026-10-30: all datasets are trained; anything outside the ATL105 composition is reported as REVIEW_REQUIRED.

openQuestions.question: PI Bit 19 MBAS Eligibility Flags (ans 20) defines position 1 (MBAS Manufacturer Discount) and position 2 (MBAS Store Discount); position 3 has a blank Eligibility Type and positions 4-20 are reserved. Confirm the meaning of position 3 and the filler for reserved positions.

The PU field usage table (page 13) has two response columns headed 310 and two headed 920 & 200 with different requirements (e.g. Purse ID R/NA, Purse Unique ID NA/R). Confirm what distinguishes them (presumed real-time vs non-real-time). The validator only enforces PU cells where both duplicated columns agree.
Section 1.11 is titled 'OC Dataset Field Usage' but its caption says 'This table presents all the OF fields'. Confirm the table describes the OC dataset (trained as OC).

OC Type values are listed for an 'Account Lookup response' and an 'Offer Redemption request', which are not among the four transaction types (310/910/920/200). The usage table only has 910 request and 310 response columns. Confirm that Account Lookup = 310 response and Offer Redemption = 910 request, and whether OC may also appear on 920/200.
PI Bit 5 Price (n 12) does not state its unit, while Bits 9, 10, 12 and 17 state 'Amount in cents'. Confirm Price is also in cents (implied decimal).

DV Bit 2 Dataset Version is formatted 'an 5' but its MM.mm value (e.g. 01.01) contains a period, which is not alphanumeric. Confirm the period is permitted and supply the actual Dataset Version value for the BUYPASS implementation. The validator accepts only the MM.mm pattern for this field.
PU Bit 7 Response Code (an 2) 'may provide additional information about a purse decline' but no values are listed. Provide the valid response codes and their meanings.

ATL105 Segment 152 caps the response at 10 PI datasets, but this document says a multi-quantity PI may be split into several PIs in the response. Confirm whether splitting can push a response above 10 PI datasets, and how the 2300 maximum applies.
Section 1.5 says a PI dataset is optional in a 310, but the table marks Item Code, Price and Item Reference Number as R for '310 & 910' requests. Confirm R means 'required when a PI is sent' for 310.

PI Bit 12 Adjustment to Price is R** in the '310 & 910' response column, and the footnote says it is not provided on a 310. Confirm it is required on 910 responses only (the validator does not require it on 310).

Existing ATL105 Segment 151 items SEG151-SME-001 (2,309 vs 3,334 segment maximum, field maximum 2300) and SEG151-SME-002 (Device vs Host origin) remain open; the validator applies the 2300 field maximum only.
Section 1.1's hex example (44 56 30 30 39 34 ... 31 2E 30 31) decodes to DV 009 40000000 1.01, which conflicts with the ASCII example DV0134000000001.01.
openQuestions.qeDecision: User decision 2026-10-30: the ASCII example is authoritative (8-byte bitmap + 5-byte value = Length 013); the hex line is treated as a documentation typo.

openQuestions.question: Requirement codes RE, CE, OE and E in the field usage tables are not defined in the document.
openQuestions.qeDecision: User decision 2026-10-30: the E suffix means the value is echoed back from the request; RE/CE/OE keep their R/C/O obligation and E alone means echo when present.

openQuestions.question: The document does not state how fixed-width fields shorter than their maximum are padded.
openQuestions.qeDecision: User decision 2026-10-30: fields are fixed width and concatenated in bit order; n is right-justified zero-filled; a, an and ans are left-justified space-filled.

openQuestions.question: The bit-to-character mapping of the 8-byte ASCII bitmap is not stated.
openQuestions.qeDecision: User decision 2026-10-30: the bitmap is 8 hexadecimal characters with Bit 1 as the most significant bit, so 40000000 means only Bit 2 is present (consistent with the ASCII example).

openQuestions.question: PU Bit 4 Sign Indicator says it is required when the 'Price' field is negative, but the PU dataset has no Price field.
openQuestions.qeDecision: User decision 2026-10-30: read as 'required when Remaining Balance is negative' (documentation copy-over from PI).

openQuestions.question: PI Bit 12 Adjustment to Price is 'Required when IH has discounted or paid for a portion or all of a PI' (page 8), but the section 1.5 usage table marks it R for 310 & 910 (R**) and 920 & 200 responses without that condition. Confirm whether a response PI that IH neither discounted nor paid must still carry Adjustment to Price (e.g. as zero). Until answered, a missing value is reported for review, not rejected.

PI Bit 14 Purse ID is 'Required on responses containing a purse' (page 9), but the section 1.5 usage table marks it R for every 310 & 910 and 920 & 200 response, and page 9 also says Item Qualification responses carry 000. Confirm whether a response with no PU dataset must still carry Purse ID (as 000). Until answered, a missing Purse ID is rejected only when the response contains a PU, and otherwise reported for review.
